integrityPolicy: Client recomputes SHA-256 over the exact UTF-8 evidence-ledger bytes and compares the result with this manifest. A mismatch is displayed as an integrity failure. The workstation script also has published SHA-256 and SHA-384 checksums for independent audit.

securityModel.network: same-origin evidence and manifest retrieval only
